title: Keto Friendly Tunisian Haricot Beans Tagine
description: A funky and velvety Tunisian dish featuring haricot beans, this keto friendly tagine is perfect for midnight cravings. It is deep fry tod and full of flavor.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the haricot beans, chicken broth, and lemon juice to the saucepan, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the tagine simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the beans are tender.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
